title: Grounded Answer Check with One Repair
hints: Normalize both sides the same way before the substring test: map curly quotes, dashes and non-breaking spaces to ASCII, lowercase, and collapse whitespace. PDF and HTML extraction break lines in the middle of sentences.
A quote must be found in a source the sentence actually cites. Finding it in some other source is a misattribution, not support.
Check the statuses in a fixed priority order. Call the model at most once, only when the first answer is below the threshold, and build the repair prompt exactly as specified.
